replace.why: The real MotorInclude.h lines 72..75 declare four `extern interrupt void ..._isr(void);` prototypes. `interrupt` is a C28x keyword and MSVC rejects it (C2054). Dropping the keyword leaves a plain `void(void)` prototype: no function name and no parameter changes. Host-build-only; the delivered source and the target build are untouched. Same patch MotorInvProtect / MotorMain / SubPrg carry.

The real DSP2803x_PieVect.h line 9 is `typedef interrupt void(*PINT)(void);` -- same C28x-only keyword. This module does not write PieVectTable at all, but the case shim's DSP2803x_Device.h includes this header exactly as the real device header does, so it has to compile. Only the keyword is removed; the struct layout is preserved verbatim.

`extern int abs(int); extern int absl(long int);` and `extern int qatan(long int);`. The case shim DSP2803x_Device.h ends with `#define int short` (required: MotorDefine.h is `typedef unsigned int Uint;`, a 16-bit storage unit on the C28x and 32-bit on the host), so `long int` would expand to `long short` -> MSVC C2632. `long` and `long int` are the same type, so the width is unchanged. This module calls the folded 16-bit `abs`; it does not call `absl` or `qatan` directly (its `atan` comes from atan_mock.c, which reaches `qatan` in hostlib_mock.c). Same patch SubPrg / MotorInvProtect / MotorMain / MotorEncoder carry.
